sourcedFrom: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. (2017 (copyright line, PDF p.34))
cleanIntro: The Maxim 9 is a striker-fired 9mm pistol with the silencer built into the frame, so it does not strip like a pistol with a barrel and recoil spring. The barrel is fixed. The slide comes off the BACK of the frame: press the recoil rod retainer button, lift the recoil rod lever, then draw the slide rearward and tilt it off. SilencerCo's full cleaning goes one level further and takes the grip off the trigger assembly by its roll pin. The silencer's baffles come out from the front cap, and the book says they seldom need cleaning. It has no magazine disconnect — it fires with the magazine out.

steps.title: Magazine out — it fires without one
steps.action: Point the muzzle in a safe direction and keep your finger outside the trigger guard. Press the magazine release and take the magazine out. It may drop free, or you may have to pull it gently from the well. Taking it out does not make the pistol safe: a round in the chamber still fires. Put the magazine and any loose rounds away from the bench before you go on.
steps.quote: Push the magazine release and remove the magazine. The magazine will either drop freely or will require gentle pulling to eject from the magazine well (6A).
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — UNLOADING, p.17
steps.warn: WARNING: THE MAXIM 9 CAN BE FIRED WITHOUT A MAGAZINE INSERTED.

steps.title: Slide fully back, fast, to throw out the chambered round
steps.action: With the magazine out, pull the slide all the way back in one quick motion. That extracts and ejects any round in the chamber. Keep your hand and fingers clear of the ejection port: blocking it can stop the round from getting out. A round that comes out is still live — set it apart.
steps.quote: After the magazine is removed, pull the slide back fully in a swift motion. This action will eject any cartridge that is currently in the chamber.
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — UNLOADING, p.17
steps.warn: Do not obstruct the ejection port while unloading; doing so can interfere with ejecting the cartridge.

steps.title: Lock the slide open on the slide catch
steps.action: Hold the slide fully back and push UP on the slide catch. Then let the slide come forward slowly until the catch stops it. If the slide runs home, it did not catch. Pull it back and try again.
steps.quote: Next, lock the slide to the rear by pushing upward on the slide catch while the slide is in the rearward position then allowing the slide to move forward slowly until the slide catch is engaged.
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — UNLOADING, p.17

steps.title: Look into the chamber — never down the muzzle
steps.action: With the slide locked back, look into the chamber through the open action. Then check the barrel and the magazine well for rounds and obstructions, by eye and by touch. Do not look in from the front. On this pistol the front is the silencer's front cap, and a muzzle is never a window. Run this check whenever the pistol has been out of your hands, before cleaning, and after anyone else has handled it.
steps.prose: The book's unloading section says the same: inspect the chamber, the barrel and the magazine well until no ammunition remains.
steps.quote: Once the Maxim 9 is unloaded, look in the chamber (NOT from the end of the muzzle) to verify it is unloaded, then visually and physically check for obstructions (2A).
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — INSPECTING YOUR MAXIM, p.11

steps.title: Press the recoil rod retainer button at the rear of the slide
steps.action: Find the recoil rod retainer button on the rear of the slide and press it in. Keep it pressed for the next step. Do not touch the trigger at any point in the strip. SilencerCo says the Maxim 9 does not need a trigger pull to come apart, and you should not give it one.
steps.prose: The book's strip does not say whether the slide should be locked back or forward when you start. It just begins at the button.
steps.quote: Depress the recoil rod retainer button, located on the rear of the slide (7A).
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — FIELD STRIPPING, p.19
steps.warn: YOU DO NOT NEED TO, NOR SHOULD YOU, PULL THE TRIGGER BEFORE OR DURING THE FIELD STRIPPING OF THE MAXIM 9.

steps.title: Lift the recoil rod lever while the button is held
steps.action: Keep the retainer button pressed and lift the recoil rod lever. Raise it all the way. The lever only comes up while the button is held in, so if it will not move, check the button first.
steps.quote: While the button is depressed, lift the recoil rod lever (7B).
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — FIELD STRIPPING, p.19

steps.title: Slide back, rear tipped down, off the back of the frame
steps.action: With the lever fully up, let go of the retainer button. Draw the slide toward the rear. When it is about halfway off, tip the rear of the slide DOWN. That lifts the front of the slide over the internal catch, and the slide comes off the back of the frame. The silencer and fixed barrel stay with the frame. If the slide stops halfway, the front has not cleared the catch: tip the rear down further. Do not force it.
steps.quote: After the recoil rod lever is fully raised, release the recoil rod retainer button. Pull the slide to the rear. Once the slide is halfway removed, tilt the rear of the slide downward (7C) so that the front of the slide clears the internal catch, then remove the slide completely (7D).
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — FIELD STRIPPING, p.19

steps.title: Frame: rails, disconnecter and sear contact points
steps.action: Use a firearm CLP and a soft brush or cloth to wipe and gently scrub the friction points on the frame. These are the two frame rails, where the disconnecter meets its pin, where the disconnecter meets the frame, and where the sear assembly meets the frame. Then lubricate the same places.
steps.prose: The book shows the frame's friction points as a numbered photo and does not name any others.
steps.quote: Once field stripped, use a reputable CLP (cleaner, lubricant, preservative) specifically formulated for firearm use and soft brush or cloth to wipe and/or gently scrub the points of friction.
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL, Field Cleaning, p.25

steps.title: Slide: delay wing, slide channels, firing pin block, firing pin
steps.action: Do the same on the slide. Clean the four places the book marks — the slide delay wing where it meets the slide, the slide's own contact surfaces, the firing pin block and the firing pin assembly — and then oil them. The book takes nothing out of the slide. Clean these parts where they sit.
steps.quote: 1. Slide Delay Wing to Slide 2. Slide to Slide 3. Firing Pin Block 4. Firing Pin Assembly
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, p.26

steps.title: Barrel: brush or wipe from the open breech
steps.action: With the slide off, the barrel's breech is open at the back of the frame. Run a 9mm brush or a cleaning wipe down the barrel from there. Follow the instructions of the kit you are using.
steps.prose: The book does not give a direction of travel or a patch routine; it hands you to your kit's instructions.
steps.quote: At this point, you can run a caliber-specific brush or cleaning wipe down the barrel of the Maxim 9. Follow all instructions outlined in your firearms cleaning kit.
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL, Field Cleaning, p.25

steps.title: No ultrasonic cleaner and no ammoniated solvent
steps.action: Use only solvents made for firearms. The finish can be damaged by the wrong cleaner. SilencerCo names ammoniated and other strong alkaline solvents as ones not to use. An ultrasonic cleaner is ruled out completely, for the pistol and for the baffles.
steps.quote: DO NOT use an ultrasonic cleaner when cleaning your Maxim 9.
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING, General, p.24
steps.warn: AMMONIATED SOLVENTS OR OTHER SUCH STRONG ALKALINE SOLVENTS SHOULD NOT BE USED ON THE MAXIM 9.

steps.title: A light coat of oil, inside and out
steps.action: When the cleaning is done, put a light coat of gun oil on the metal parts, inside and out. Wipe the outside with a non-abrasive cloth. Field clean after every time you fire it, and after exposure to weather or dirt. Do the full cleaning in Deep Clean every 500 to 1,000 rounds. In the cold, use an oil light enough that it will not thicken.
steps.quote: After you are done cleaning the Maxim 9, apply a light coating of gun oil to coat the internal and external metal parts.
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING, General continued, p.25

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: On the bench: the frame, which still carries the grip, the fixed barrel and the silencer, plus the slide and the magazine. That is the whole field strip. SilencerCo's full cleaning starts from here. It takes the grip off to reach the trigger assembly, and you can also open the silencer's baffles. Both are in Deep Clean. Deep Clean is at the end of the clean steps.
steps.quote: FULL CLEANING To fully clean your Maxim 9, first complete the field stripping steps then remove the grip to access the trigger assembly.
steps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, Full Cleaning, p.26
steps.warn: DO NOT DISASSEMBLE THE MAXIM 9 BEYOND WHAT IS OUTLINED IN THIS MANUAL.

deepSteps.title: Trigger assembly roll pin out — on a rubber mat, 5/32 punch
deepSteps.action: Find the trigger assembly roll pin in the grip. Put a rubber mat or another shock-absorbing, non-metallic pad between the pistol and the hard bench. Then drift the roll pin out of the grip with a 5/32 punch. Keep the pin. It goes back in at the end.
deepSteps.quote: To remove the grip, locate the trigger assembly roll pin (12A). Place a rubber mat or other shock-absorbing, non-metallic object between the Maxim 9 and a hard work surface. Using a 5/32 punch or similar device, remove the roll pin from the Maxim 9 grip (12B).
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, Full Cleaning, p.26

deepSteps.title: Grip off — down and rearward, rocked past the two lugs
deepSteps.action: Hold the silencer section in one hand. With the other, pull the grip down and toward the rear. Two lugs seat into the rear of the top of the grip, and they are what holds it. If the grip sticks, rock it back and forth until the lugs clear. Do not pry it.
deepSteps.quote: Once the roll pin is removed, grasp the silencer portion of the Maxim 9 with one hand while pulling the grip of the Maxim 9 in a down and rearward direction (12C).
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, Full Cleaning, p.26

deepSteps.title: Trigger assembly: clean and oil the friction points
deepSteps.action: With the grip off, the trigger assembly is open. Use a soft brush and a firearm CLP on every part that rubs, especially the sear assembly where it meets the frame and the disconnecter. Then lubricate the same places. Clean the parts where they sit. The book takes nothing out of the trigger assembly.
deepSteps.quote: Take care to clean all parts that are subjected to friction.
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, p.27

deepSteps.title: Grip back: trigger through the larger, rearmost cutout
deepSteps.action: To put the grip back, first pass the trigger through its cutout in the frame. It is the larger cutout, and the one nearest the rear of the trigger-guard area. If the trigger goes into the wrong opening, the grip will not seat.
deepSteps.quote: To reassemble, first place the trigger through the trigger cutout in the frame (12F). The trigger cutout is the larger and rearmost cutout in the trigger guard area.
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, p.27

deepSteps.title: Grip up and rearward so the lugs seat
deepSteps.action: Once the trigger is through, pull the grip rearward while you bring it up to the frame. That lets the lugs at the rear of the frame assembly drop into the grip. Lugs first. Then the rest of the grip closes up.
deepSteps.quote: Once the trigger passes through the opening, pull the grip of the Maxim 9 rearward while bringing the grip up to meet the frame to ensure the lugs in the rear of the frame assembly seat into the grip (12G).
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, p.27

deepSteps.title: Holes aligned, roll pin back in
deepSteps.action: With the lugs seated, press the frame fully into the grip. Line up the hole in the grip with the matching hole in the frame. Then drive the roll pin back in, on the same mat. If the holes do not line up, the frame is not fully seated: do not drive the pin until they do.
deepSteps.quote: After the frame lugs are seated into the grip, fully seat the frame into the grip. Ensure the grip hole aligns with the corresponding hole in the frame (12H). Replace the roll pin that was removed in earlier steps (12J).
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING PISTOL CONTINUED, p.28

deepSteps.title: Baffles: only when they need it
deepSteps.action: The silencer has so much internal volume that its baffles seldom need cleaning. Do them as part of the full cleaning when needed, never in a field clean. They are opened the same way as for the silencer-length change, with the slide off the frame, which it already is.
deepSteps.quote: Because the Maxim 9 has such a substantial amount of internal volume, there is no need to regularly clean the baffles.
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING BAFFLES, p.28

deepSteps.title: Front cap off — Allen key on the two sex bolts
deepSteps.action: With the Allen key that came with the pistol, unscrew the sex bolts in the front cap and take them out. The rods may come out with the bolts. That depends on carbon build-up, and it is not a problem.
deepSteps.quote: Using the provided Allen key, unscrew the sex bolts in the front cap of the Maxim 9 (9A). Remove the bolts.
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CHANGING SILENCER LENGTH, p.21

deepSteps.title: Front cap and short baffle off, then the next two baffles
deepSteps.action: Take off the front cap and the short baffle behind it, and set them aside in order. Then take out the next two baffles. Baffle 1, at the back, stays in the silencer. The book never takes it out. Keep the baffles in the order they came out.
deepSteps.prose: The length change goes on to unscrew the long rods and fit the short ones. That is a configuration change, not cleaning, and it is not needed to reach the baffles.
deepSteps.quote: Remove the front cap and the subsequent short baffle and set aside. These will be reinstalled at a later step (9B).
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CHANGING SILENCER LENGTH, p.21

deepSteps.title: Wipe or brush the baffles — soak only the hard deposits
deepSteps.action: Wipe or scrub the debris off the baffles with a damp cloth or a non-abrasive brush. For stubborn deposits, soak the baffles in a hydrocarbon-based solvent, such as WD-40, some mineral spirits or lacquer thinner. Then scrub them again. No ultrasonic cleaner. If a baffle's finish has discoloured, wiping it with a good gun oil brings it back.
deepSteps.quote: SilencerCo recommends using a damp cloth or nonabrasive brush to gently wipe or scrub away debris.
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING BAFFLES, p.28
deepSteps.warn: DO NOT use an ultrasonic cleaner.

deepSteps.title: Baffles bone dry before they go back
deepSteps.action: After a soak, scrub away what is left with a non-abrasive brush or cloth. Make sure every baffle is completely dry before reassembly. If you used a water-based cleaner, give the baffles a light coat of oil or another corrosion-resistant product afterwards.
deepSteps.quote: After soaking, wipe or scrub away debris with a nonabrasive brush or cloth. Ensure that the baffles are completely dry before reassembling.
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — CLEANING BAFFLES, p.28

deepSteps.title: Baffles back together — no gaps at the seams
deepSteps.action: Put the baffles back in the order they came out, then the short baffle and the front cap. Thread the sex bolts back in through the front cap and tighten them. The book's torque for the sex bolts is 45 in/lbs. Then look along the silencer: every seam between baffles must be closed. If you can see a gap, do not fire it. Take it apart and seat the baffles again.
deepSteps.quote: Check that there are no gaps between the baffles of the silencer portion of the Maxim 9 before firing. The seams of the baffles must be fully seated together to ensure personal safety and proper operation.
deepSteps.cite: SILENCERCO MAXIM 9 INSTRUCTION MANUAL — ⛔ No form or revision code is printed in this book. — WARNING, p.3
deepSteps.warn: DO NOT fire the Maxim 9 if there is a gap between the baffles.

cleaning.name: FRAME
tasks: Firearm CLP and a soft brush or cloth on the friction points
Disconnecter where it meets its pin, and where it meets the frame
Sear assembly where it meets the frame
Lubricate the same places once they are clean

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Slide delay wing where it meets the slide
The slide's contact surfaces and the channels that ride the frame rails
Lubricate the same places once they are clean — nothing comes out of the slide

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: 9mm brush or a cleaning wipe down the barrel from the open breech
Never look down the muzzle — check the barrel from the chamber end

cleaning.name: SOLVENTS & CARE
tasks: Do not use an ultrasonic cleaner, on the pistol or the baffles
Do not use ammoniated or other strong alkaline solvents — they damage the finish
Light coat of gun oil on the metal parts, inside and out
Outside: a non-abrasive cloth and a little gun oil
Field clean after every firing or exposure to the elements; full clean every 500-1,000 rounds
Do not store it with a plugged front cap, or in leather or heavy cloth

reassembly: Line up the slide's channels with the two rails on the frame.
Tilt the slide at about 30 degrees and seat it so the rails start into the channels.
Press the slide forward slightly until the channels and rails engage, then drop the front of the slide down onto the frame; it now moves back and forth on the rails.
With the slide forward, press the recoil rod retainer button and close the recoil rod lever.
Cycle the slide to confirm it works.
fncheck: With the pistol confirmed empty, chamber and magazine well, cycle the slide several times. It must run freely and return fully forward. That is the only function check the book gives. Before you fire it again, check that the barrel and the silencer are clear of any obstruction, and that there is no gap at any baffle seam. The book says not to fire it with a gap.
